_note: Single source for the August Finals surfaces (/finals, /finals/live, /winners). status: 'pending' (finalists named, battles not yet run) | 'live' (battles running) | 'settled' (results final). /finals/live renders the roster as soon as finalists[] is non-empty; /winners stays on its placeholders until settled:true with ranks filled. Each finalist: rank (final placement 1..N, or null pre-settlement), name, handle (e.g. @builder), repo (owner/repo), demo (URL), track (artist|builder|creator), prize, collectible ('champion'|'finisher'). Finalists are PEOPLE, not projects - two per track, picked by Zaal after the board closed on 2026-08-16. There was no vote. Battles run on live WaveWarZ community battles, not WaveWarZ-Base.
_battles_note: The three head-to-head battles, rendered by /august and by the next-battle card on /live. TO PUBLISH A BATTLE: fill date (YYYY-MM-DD), time (display string, timezone included - the /live countdown parses the label, so use EDT or EST), watch (stream URL) and window (one sentence describing how the battle actually runs), then flip status to 'scheduled'. poll is the URL of that battle's open poll on X - paste it in when the poll goes up and every surface renders a Vote button; leave it null and no button appears. battleUrl is where the charts live - wavewarz.com for now; swap it for a per-battle URL if one ever exists and every surface follows. spaces is for a battle that has MORE THAN ONE Space - an array of { label, date, time, ends, url }. The slot times render even while url is null, so people know when to show up before the links exist; paste each url in as it is created and that slot becomes a link. Use space (singular) for a one-Space battle and spaces (plural) for a multi-Space one; a battle may set either, and the builder battle uses spaces. judges is the panel for that battle - an array of names; a null entry renders as TBA, so a seat that is not filled yet is shown as unfilled rather than hidden. Omit the field entirely and no judges line renders at all. space is the X Space URL. Schedule the Space in advance and paste the URL here: people can then set a reminder, which matters because the Space is hosted on the WaveWarZ account rather than an account this audience follows. No HTML edit needed. window is the single source of truth for the timing - do not restate it in page copy, or it drifts. Artist and creator run inside a one-hour Space; builder is a 24 hour battle with endDate/endTime. status: 'scheduling' | 'scheduled' | 'live' | 'done'.

battles.window: Space opens 5:00 PM EDT. The battle runs 5:15 to 5:45, and the winner is called before the Space ends.

A 24 hour battle, noon Saturday to noon Sunday. It opens with a Space the hour before, 11:00 AM to 12:00 PM EDT Saturday, to talk through what both builders made this season; the clock starts when that Space ends. It closes with a Space in the last hour, 11:00 AM to 12:00 PM EDT Sunday, where both share what they built in the 24. In between they build in the open and the battle can be traded the whole way through. When either builder has something to show mid-run they reach Zaal directly and he opens a Space so they can share it, so extra Spaces can appear at any hour.
Space opens 5:00 PM EDT. The battle runs 5:15 to 5:45, and the winner is called before the Space ends.
